'''Scotia Belford-Tapalo''' was a [[humanoid]] [[Gender|female]] who served as [[Monarch of Naboo|Queen]] [[Consort]] of the [[planet]] [[Naboo]] as part of the [[Royal House of Naboo]]. By the [[Battle of Naboo]]<ref name="CLNE" /> in [[32 BBY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> a [[Color|white]] statue of Belford-Tapalo that embodied Naboo's [[Naboo classical architecture|classical style]] stood atop the dome of the [[Theed Hangar|royal hangar]] in [[Theed]], the [[capital]] [[city]] of the [[Naboo (people)|Naboo]] people.<ref name="CLNE" /> The [[hangar]]'s construction began during the reign of [[King]] [[Bon Tapalo]].<ref name="BMF24">{{BuildFalconCite|24|Guide to the Galaxy}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
A statue of Scotia Belford-Tapalo first appeared in the [[1999]] [[prequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> The character was first identified in the [[2025]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations, New Edition]]''.<ref name="CLNE" /> The new material in the book was written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Emily Shkoukani]].<ref name="Bluesky">{{Bluesky|jasoncfry.bsky.social|post/3ljusdhg5mc26|[[Jason Fry]]|date=2025-03-08|quote=Just got a copy of the newly revised Star Wars: Complete Locations from DK, out Tuesday! I wrote the updates with the peerless @shkouks.bsky.social. You'll find 12 new artworks, an updated galaxy map, new and reworked planet profiles, and details and Easter eggs galore. And a glorious cover!|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/CJuwQ|archivefile=File:JasonFry-CompleteLocationsNewEdition-Bluesky.png}} {{C|@shkouks.bsky.social confirmed to be [[Emily Shkoukani]] by {{Bluesky|tarkinstopshelf.bsky.social|post/3kjlh6aw5ry2k|[[Tarkin's Top Shelf]]|date=2024-01-22|quote=New Episode! #296: Dawn of Rebellion with @shkouks.bsky.social and @infinata.bsky.social! Your hosts welcome Emily Shkoukani and Pablo Hidalgo to the show! They discuss the creative process behind the Visual Guide and get to know their guests with some fun #StarWars questions!📚|archiveurl=https://ghostarchive.org/archive/eePoa|archivefile=File:TarkinsTopShelf-Shkoukani-Bluesky.png}}}}</ref>
